card.name: Just before a drug name or dose
card.fires_on: Words and pieces right before a brand or drug name is completed, such as the first letter of a brand name after 'dose of' or 'taken'. Also fires on small linking words and digits just before an estrogen or antiplatelet name or a rate figure.

modes.label: Start of brand name
modes.description: The first piece of a capitalized brand or drug name, such as T in TCA, TachoSil or TEGISON.

modes.label: Linking word before a drug
modes.description: A small word or bracket right before a named drug or product.
modes.example: the aspirin<< in>> this product may not provide adequate treatment for

modes.label: Digits in risk rates
modes.description: A digit or space inside a per-10,000 women-years figure.

card.writes: It seems to push toward starting a new name or term, and away from words like free or down.
card.plain: It lights up at the spot just before a drug name or a risk figure is spelled out.
